---
name: Platform software report
about: Build and software checks on your OS, without an instrument
---

No instrument is needed. Do not run production workers or ordinary Argyll tools
for this report. Redact personal paths and private data from a COPY of logs.
Keep original results locally. Do not attach full batches or bench folders.

- App commit/tree; driver source commits/trees from import manifests:
- OS/version, architecture, Python/uv/Node/npm/compiler version and target:
- Exact command, exit and first failure (if any):
- Native, generic/chart, MAT and renderer summaries:
- Verbatim final Tree, Skipped (with reasons), and Scope lines:
- Environment limitations or conditional skips:
- Public credit handle (optional; leaving blank means no attribution requested):

PARTIAL is expected for platform-specific exclusions; do not suppress skips or
call it full-form acceptance. Missing prerequisites and failures are useful too.
